package postgres

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestNextActionPracticeCommandRechecksProgression(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name     string
		statuses []domain.LearningPathItemStatus
		position int
		want     bool
	}{
		{"first ready", []domain.LearningPathItemStatus{domain.LearningPathItemReady}, 0, true},
		{"completed predecessor", []domain.LearningPathItemStatus{domain.LearningPathItemCompleted, domain.LearningPathItemPlanned}, 1, true},
		{"mastered predecessor", []domain.LearningPathItemStatus{domain.LearningPathItemSkippedMastered, domain.LearningPathItemPlanned}, 1, true},
		{"stale later action", []domain.LearningPathItemStatus{domain.LearningPathItemInProgress, domain.LearningPathItemReady}, 1, false},
		{"unfinished predecessor", []domain.LearningPathItemStatus{domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, domain.LearningPathItemReady}, 1, false},
		{"other active activity", []domain.LearningPathItemStatus{domain.LearningPathItemReady, domain.LearningPathItemInProgress}, 0, false},
		{"completed target", []domain.LearningPathItemStatus{domain.LearningPathItemCompleted}, 0, false},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			items := make([]domain.LearningPathItem, len(tc.statuses))
			for i, s := range tc.statuses {
				items[i] = domain.LearningPathItem{Position: i, Status: s}
			}
			if got := practiceProgressionStartAllowed(items, tc.position); got != tc.want {
				t.Fatalf("allowed=%v want=%v", got, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
